# v0.2.5 - zip 9

## zip 9.5.1

anydoc opens docx, xlsx, pptx, odt and the other ZIP-based formats through the `zip` crate, which moves from 8.6.0 to 9.5.1. Five advisories affect every 8.x release: CVE-2026-115905 (critical), CVE-2026-115907, CVE-2026-115908 and CVE-2026-115909 (high), and CVE-2026-115906 (moderate). A crate that depends on both anydoc and `zip` can now drop zip 8 from its lockfile. The MSRV stays at 1.88.

## Headers survive a repeated label

A CSV, xlsx or ods table lost its header when a body cell repeated one of the column labels: the output got a blank header row and the real labels moved into the body. The header now stays whenever the column types point to one.

```
city,region,pop
Paris,north,100
Lyon,region,200
```

renders with `| city | region | pop |` as the header again. A table with no type evidence and a repeated first-row value is still treated as headerless.

## Hosted OCR: choose the Parse mode

`parseMode` in Node, `parse_mode` in Python and `--parse-mode` on the CLI pick the Firecrawl Parse PDF mode for hosted OCR: `auto` (the default) extracts text and falls back to OCR, `fast` extracts text only, `ocr` OCRs every page. Any other value is rejected before anything is sent.

```js
const markdown = await toMarkdown('scan.pdf', { ocr: 'hosted', parseMode: 'ocr' });
```
